about: One voice per speaker, everywhere: pre-rendered lines, and live TTS of any line without a clip (the TV's /api/tts with theme tactics.npc.<id>). Presets are Gemini TTS / Chirp3-HD voice names (en-US-Chirp3-HD-<preset>). Player voice sets have two casts each (low, high). NPCs have one; where two speakers must share a preset, a pitch shift (semitones) or a filter keeps them apart in the pre-rendered clips. Filters can't reach live TTS, so major speakers get presets of their own. The ArcBox host (lobby) is Puck, so Wardenflame keeps Puck off its speakers.

filters.helm: A voice inside a closed helm: short metallic reflections and the top end rolled off.
filters.echo: A faint cold echo, as if the room were larger and older than it looks.
filters.fey: A soft shimmer: a quiet, slightly detuned double behind the voice.
